name: Michigan Dogman
description: A bipedal, dog-headed humanoid cryptid reported primarily in the northwestern Lower Peninsula of Michigan, popularized by a 1987 radio prank song by disc jockey Steve Cook of WTCM-FM in Traverse City.
origin: Reports cluster in the northwestern Lower Peninsula of Michigan, particularly around the Manistee River and historically Odawa lands; occasional reports extend into other Great Lakes states.
